_comment: Machine-mm (X,Y) position of the CENTER of each fixed ArUco calibration marker glued to the bed corners. Edit these four to match your actual machine after printing/sticking the markers -- see VISION_ALIGNMENT.md step 2. Default layout assumes a 250x250mm bed (MACHINE_CALIBRATION_GUIDE.md) with markers 15mm in from each corner; adjust workAreaX/workAreaY-based values to your machine.
